title: Can LLMs Predict Social Science Results?
body: GPT-4 predicted results of 70 experiments (119,000+ people) about as well as human forecasters, but overstated effect sizes.

title: Multi-Perspective LLM Annotations
body: For subjective ratings like politeness, groups truly disagree: it targets scarce human labels where the LLM misjudges most.

title: Out of One: Silicon Samples
body: GPT-3 given real respondents' backstories yields simulated samples that mirror human response patterns.
